maya: Quick upload of KV-cache paging/eviction bench across GPUs + regions. Focus: seq length mix (short/medium/long), cache hit rate vs p95 latency, and kernel choice impact. Raw run in S3: s3://redwood-bench/kvcache/1763412345.tar.gz

maya: TL;DR: hit rate >75% gives ~35-45% p95 win on A100/H100. But at low hit rates (<50%) H100 shows higher p95 due to slower fallback kernel for paging. us-west-2 performed slightly better than eu-west-1 for long sequences (network+NUMA noise).

liam: Nice. Can you paste the key numbers?

maya: Sure — pasted snippet from the summary CSV: (seq mix = 20% short(16), 60% mid(256), 20% long(2048))

maya (code): ```
config, gpu, region, hit_rate, p95_latency_ms, throughput_tok_s
seqmix_A, A100, us-west-2, 82%, 68, 95000
seqmix_A, H100, us-west-2, 61%, 102, 112000
seqmix_A, A100, eu-west-1, 78%, 75, 90000
seqmix_A, H100, eu-west-1, 58%, 118, 108000
seqmix_A, G5, us-west-2, 70%, 140, 78000
```

sophia: Hmm H100 throughput higher but p95 worse when hit rate drops. Makes sense if KV page eviction triggers slower kernels. Did you test different eviction policies?

maya: Yes — compared LRU vs LFU vs size-aware LRU. LFU gives marginally better long-term hit rates for repeat prompts, but LRU is simpler and lower overhead on the runtime. Results: LFU improved hit rate by ~4% on mixed traces but added ~3-4ms overhead per request in our runtime version.

alex: Any config we can try in prod to reduce p95 without big infra changes?

maya: A few safe levers we tested:
- increase in-memory cache capacity by 1.5x for mid seqs (reduced paging by ~22%)
- tune paging threshold: prefer async prefetch for seqs >1024
- enable kernel hinting: prefer fp16 fused attention kernel when hit rate <60% to reduce token-cost for fallback

chris: Can you show the p95 vs hit-rate curve? A simple ascii chart is fine.

maya: Pasted curve (x=hit rate, y=p95 ms, avg across GPUs)

maya (code): ```
Hit% | A100_p95 | H100_p95 | G5_p95
95   | 42      | 50      | 110
85   | 58      | 72      | 125
75   | 68      | 102     | 140
60   | 95      | 118     | 165
45   | 140     | 210     | 230
```

liam: That gap between A100 and H100 at 45% hit is huge for p95. Did you profile which kernel is used when cache miss occurs?

maya: Yes — stack traces show: when miss and paging occurs, H100 path fell back to a non-batched kernel that does device->host staging and serialized IO more often. A100 runtime had an optimized dma+scatter kernel that kept more on-GPU. We filed infra ticket with kernel team.

perf-bot: benchmark-run 1763412345 completed — artifacts: /benchmarks/kvcache/1763412345/ (logs, flamegraphs, perf counters).

sophia: Any region-specific notes? eu got worse long-seq p95 by ~7-10ms vs us-west. Suspect instance NUMA pinning + NVLink topology differences. Also our eu hardware was slightly older H100 revision.

maya: Right — we re-ran with strict CPU pinning and saw eu-west-1 improve ~6ms for long seqs. Recommendation: enforce cpu-affinity for paging threads in prod for long sequence workloads.

alex: For Dedicated customers we can flip kernel hinting via model config? How invasive is the change?

maya: It's a config flag at the model-serving layer: "kv_cache.paging.kernel_hint": "prefer_fp16_fused_on_miss". Example snippet:

maya (code): ```json
{"model":"redwood-v2-13b","kv_cache": {"capacity_mb": 2048, "paging": {"enabled": true, "async_prefetch_threshold_seq": 1024, "kernel_hint": "prefer_fp16_fused_on_miss", "eviction_policy": "lru_size_aware"}}}
```

chris: Any quality regressions from kernel hinting/quantization? We need evals.

maya: We ran n=200 prompt evals on rouge/bertscore and saw negligible quality delta (<0.2% on BERTSim) for fp16 fused fallback. Quantization to q4f16 needs separate QA.

liam: Next steps?

maya: Action items: 
- (maya) open kernel ticket with perf traces + flamegraphs (done).
- (eng-runtime) try async prefetch threshold at 512/1024 for a 48-hr soak in staging.
- (sophia) run eval suite on fp16 fused fallback and q4f16 baseline before flipping for Dedicated customers.
- (alex) draft config toggle and safe rollout steps for Dedicated customers.

sophia: I'll schedule the evals today, ETA 36h.

perf-bot: created issue RED-3782: "H100 fallback kernel: serialized paging path"

maya: Thanks all — feel free to ask for the raw flamegraphs. I'll drop links in thread. :thumbsup:
